summary: Frontend-only testing of Events page mobile responsive fixes. Successfully verified that header, buttons, tabs, view mode toggle, and filter controls are properly compact on mobile (375px) and full-sized on desktop (1920px). All 10 requested features tested.
critical_code_review_comments: EventManager.js (lines 397-436): Header responsive classes are correctly implemented - title h1 uses 'text-base sm:text-2xl', subtitle has 'hidden sm:block', Create button has responsive span with 'sm:hidden' for mobile '+ New' and 'hidden sm:inline' for desktop '+ Create Event'

EventsList.js (lines 508-625): Tabs use 'py-2 px-3 sm:py-3 sm:px-6' for compact mobile padding, view mode buttons show 'List/Detail/Cal' text with 'text-[10px] sm:text-xs', dropdowns are appropriately compact at 120px and 73px on mobile
seed_data_creation: None - Used existing 25 events (3 upcoming, 14+ past)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Events page mobile responsive fixes tested and working. Navigation: Login -> Events button in bottom nav (data-testid='bottom-nav-events'). This is the PUBLIC-FACING events page (UnifiedEventsPage -> EventManager -> EventsList), NOT the AdminEventsView.

3_mobile_create_button_compact.details: Create Event button structure verified - has + New for mobile and + Create Event for desktop. Code review confirms correct implementation.

4_mobile_refresh_button.details: Refresh button visible and compact on mobile with 'px-2.5 py-1.5 sm:px-4 sm:py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm' classes

5_mobile_tabs_compact.details: Upcoming/Past tabs show counts (3/14), 180px width each on mobile with 'py-2 px-3 sm:py-3 sm:px-6' responsive padding

6_mobile_view_toggle_compact.details: View mode toggle shows 'List | Detail | Cal' with text-[10px] sm:text-xs compact text on mobile

7_mobile_dropdowns_compact.details: Status filter: 120px, Sort dropdown: 73px - both compact and fit in one row on mobile with 'text-[10px] sm:text-xs' classes

8_desktop_full_title_subtitle.details: Desktop shows 'Events' title at text-2xl, subtitle visible with display: block

9_desktop_create_button_full.details: Desktop shows full '+ Create Event' text (desktopSpanVisible: true), mobile text hidden

10_view_mode_switching.details: All 3 view modes (List/Detail/Calendar) switch correctly on both mobile and desktop viewports
